title: Central limit theorems for non-linear functionals of Gaussian fields via Wiener chaos decomposition
abstract: We review and present some known results for non-linear functionals of Gaussian variables in the context of discrete Gaussian fields defined on the $d$ dimensional lattice. Our main result is a Central Limit Theorem in the spirit of the classical Breuer-Major theorem, together with applications to the powers of the Gaussian Free Field. Notably, we show that even powers of the discrete Gaussian Free Field converge to the Gaussian white noise, while odd powers converge to a continuous Gaussian Free Field with explicit covariance. The proofs are based on the Wiener chaos decomposition and the fourth moment theorem (Nualart-Peccati, 2005), and include a tightness result. Even if these tools are well-known in the literature, their application to Gaussian fields on the lattice appears to be new.
